story.title: Who We Are
story.text: SAMI Auto Service is a locally owned traditional workshop specializing in honest repair work without the corporate overhead and inflated prices of national service chains. Every vehicle that comes through our doors is handled personally by experienced mechanics who take pride in their craft. We believe in one-on-one accountability — when you bring your car to us, you're dealing directly with the people who will fix it.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: To deliver direct, high-quality, and transparent auto mechanical services that keep our community moving safely.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.text: To remain the most trusted local reference point for reliable, stress-free vehicle maintenance and repair.

hero.title: Frequently Asked Questions
hero.subtitle: Quick answers about our services, pricing, and repair process.

items.question: What vehicles do you work on?
items.answer: We work on all makes and models including sedans, SUVs, trucks, and commercial vehicles. Our mechanics have experience with both domestic and imported vehicles.

items.question: Do I need to book in advance?
items.answer: No appointment is required. You can call or visit our workshop directly. However, scheduling ahead helps us prepare for your specific needs and reduces wait time.

items.question: How are diagnostic fees calculated?
items.answer: Our diagnostic fee is a flat rate based on the type of inspection needed. We provide the fee upfront before any work begins, so there are no surprises.

items.question: Do you provide transparent quotes?
items.answer: Absolutely. We provide a detailed written quote for all recommended repairs before any work is performed. You approve all work and costs upfront.

items.question: Can I bring my own replacement parts?
items.answer: Yes, you may bring your own parts. However, we cannot guarantee fitment or warranty on customer-supplied parts. We recommend using parts sourced through us for guaranteed compatibility.

items.question: Do you guarantee repair durability?
items.answer: All repairs performed by SAMI Auto Service are backed by our workmanship guarantee. We stand behind the quality of our work and use quality parts to ensure lasting results.
